{{Top|leg}}
The '''Chamber of the Dark Justice''' was a court room contained within [[Scardia Station]], a cubical [[Space station/Legends|space station]] that served as a base of operations for the [[Church of the Dark Side]] in [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]. The Chamber hosted the trials of individuals who were considered traitors to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The room was equipped with an ancient [[Duro/Legends|durese]] throne perched on a platform so that the judge&mdash;a diminutive [[Bimm/Legends|Bimm]] [[Rajah Ubooki|agent]] posing as [[Supreme Prophet]] [[Kadann]]&mdash;would appear taller.
